description: The latest model of an AI model family (gpt, claude, gemini, llama, grok, mistral, deepseek, qwen and the others the record follows): the newest release with its date and source, the current model of each line with the flagship marked, and the family's answer sentence. Use it for "what is the latest Claude model" or "which GPT is current". Without family: the families the record follows and the newest release across them.

family.description: A family key, e.g. claude, gpt, gemini. Omit to list the families.
